div.head: III Eg 8.2
div.ab: ⁊ ga seo wæg wulle to ealfan punde, ⁊ hie nan man ná deoror ne sylle.
⁊ ga seo wæge wulle to CXX [p'], ⁊ nan man hy na undeoror ne sylle.
Et eat pondus lane pro dimidia libra, et nemo carius uendat eam.
⁊ ga seo wæge wulle to CXX p', ⁊ nan man hig undeoror ne sille.
And a wey of wool shall be sold for 120 pence, and no-one shall sell it at a cheaper rate.
Und es gehe das ‘Gewicht’ [etwa 1½ Centner?] Wolle zu ½ Pfund (= 120 Pfennigen A D) Silber, und es verkaufe sie niemand billiger (theurer G Qu).
And let a ‘wey’ [about 1½ hundredweight?] of wool go for ½ pound (= 120 pence, A D) of silver, and let no one sell it more cheaply (more dearly, G Qu).
div.note: ‘p'’ is supplied in A from D. G's ‘deoror’ should be corrected to ‘undeoror’ (A, D, G2). In G a blank line follows, then in the same hand the rubrics of Alfred (above, p. 16). Co cites 8.2 ‘de legibus Eadgari, ut apud S. Augustinum extra Cantuariam inueni’.
